keys.alreadyRegistered: That key is already registered. Use a different key.
keys.backupHint: Keep your backup key somewhere safe. You need one key to open Admin.
keys.cancelled: The key check was cancelled or timed out. Try again.
keys.confirmFirst: Confirm with a key you already registered, then add the new key.
keys.failed: The security key check failed. Try again.
keys.firstHint: Admin stays locked until two security keys are registered.
keys.foot: Confirmation lasts 15 minutes. Freezing or suspending a page may ask again.
keys.hint: Insert your security key and touch it when it blinks, or hold it to the back of your phone. You may be asked for its PIN.
keys.intro: Security keys confirm it's you before Admin opens. Keep at least two: one you carry and a backup.
keys.limit: You've registered the most keys allowed. Remove one first.
keys.lostBody: Use your backup key if you have it. If every key is lost, the site operator resets them (see SECURITY.md). Then you register two new keys.
keys.name: Key name
keys.onlyKey: You can't remove your only key. Add another key first.
keys.removeBody: To remove a key, confirm with another registered key ({others}). You can add it back later.
keys.setupIntro: Register two security keys: one you carry and a backup.
keys.signInAgain: For your safety, the first key must be added soon after you sign in. Sign out, sign in again, and add it within 5 minutes.
keys.touchToRegister: Touch your key to register it…
keys.unsupported: This browser can't use security keys. Try a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
keys.wrongSite: This key check only works on the StreamBullets address.
landing.tagline: Suggest topics. Vote. Shape the stream.
moderation.freezeBody: The page stays public, but nobody can post, vote, react, run polls or edit it, the owner included. Existing content stays readable.
moderation.sensitive: {action} @{handle} is a sensitive action. Confirm with your security key to continue.
moderation.suspendBody: The page is hidden from the public, the Streamers list and the OBS overlay. Nothing is deleted. The owner can still see it but can't act on it.
moderation.unfreezeBody: Everyone can post, vote and run polls on the page again.
moderation.unsuspendBody: The page becomes public again and returns to the Streamers list.
page.backgroundHelp: Background images are public. JPG, PNG, or WebP, up to 5 MB.
page.cropDescription: The circle is what shows in your header and on the Streamers list.

page.handleLocked: You changed your handle recently. You can change it again on {date}.
page.handleWarning: Your page and overlay URLs will change. Update your OBS source and shared links after saving.
